subject: literacy
concept: Unit review and mastery check for P3 Text Structure, and full P3 Literacy year-end review
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of story-element and text-structure questions spanning nodes 01-07

next_node_on_fail: LITERACY.P3.TEXT_STRUCTURE.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
